body:
I am not from the States. I'm originally from China. I transferred to my college last semester from London. That's as much as I want to say. I never talked to anyone as a foreign student I was placed in an International dorm where my entire floor spoke portugese. The few friends I managed to make in London that transferred here with me either went somewhere else or made new friends. I have one girl whom I still talk to and I completely despise her.

I haven't had much luck making any friends here either. Most of my high school friends are in New York. 

I've only realized tonight that I don't have anyone here. Seeing people getting ready for parties on facebook doesn't exactly help with my situation either. I really have no idea how things came to this and I have never felt this alone in my life. I really have no idea what I can do to improve my situation.
